notes.title: Version 1.0.2.4 - Improved performance and character control
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e581cd240ed7ae866cc41cf6098fa817e12f39f0.png

Hallo Ellarians,

We just uploaded a new version with major overall performance improvement, reduced loading time between map travel, and a better character movement and jumping.

One of our biggest changes was to reduce the impact of having a large number of characters in the same place. We introduced a new system that changes the character resolution dynamically based on their clothing and complexity, and their distance from the camera. This system reduces the character performance issues by 80% and increases the frame rate by as much as 15 extra frames per second.

In addition, we went over thousands of textures and items optimized them. This optimizations increases the game performance by 25%-50%, the required memory by 25%, and the loading time between maps by as much as 30%. 

As a result of these changes, you should notice a significant improvement to LoE performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/70782c0348bbc563b8f890f7416f5622e8d9079d.jpg

Another improvement that we've made is to the character movement and jumping, as well as the camera following the player. These changes makes sure that you will have a more intuitive and smoother movement and jumping, without changing too much of the character stats.

Our next goal is to improve the story line and quests, In the meanwhile, We wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to optimize and improve other parts of LoE as much as we can.

Version 1.0.2.4 Changes (7/2/23)

 Reduced NPC performance cost by 50% near the camera
 Reduced NPC performance cost by up to 90% when far away from camera
 Multiple texture and model reduction, by up to 75% of the original size without losing graphics
 Increased overall graphic performance by up to 50% (depending on the region)
 Reduced the size of the game and memory (RAM) by 25%
 Reduced game loading time between regions by up to 30% (depending on the region)
 Improved character movement and jumping

notes.title: New milestones and planned major changes.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e9826197ed08d93a713f826e4de6faed56ce1258.png

Dear Ellarians.

We've made new features and important fixes in the last year, and now it's time to focus on old features. We're going to improve and remaster important parts of Legends of Ellaria.

Since we're more than an year after the full release, we're going to be creative and change core game elements, such as the character movement and loading screen. We've read your feedbacks and feel that these elements would be more important for you than adding a new feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/70782c0348bbc563b8f890f7416f5622e8d9079d.jpg

So, we're going to work on the following things

1: Player Controller

Player Movement feeling(speed, animations e.t.c).
Player Combat moves and feeling.

2: RPG - Combat

Fix Skills/Abilities based on your feedbacks.
Rebalance The Skill Tree and bonuses.

3: Loading Screens

Remove the loading screens whenever possible.
Decrease loading screen times.
Make a more immersive loading screen.

4: Performance

Improve Framerate.
Reduce system requirements.

5: Tutorial:

Mara (Chapter 0) will remain as it is, but will be converted to a mission instead of a game tutorial
Tutorial will start from Chapter 1, and will help the player to get familiar with the game

6: Missions:

Some missions will be rebuilt to improve the game lowness and to work better with a new tutorial.
Improve repeating missions and unnecessarily long missions.

7: RTS Combat:

Fix AI Behavior.
Fix AI response to the player tactics.

8: Graphics:

Improve general graphics.
Add some missing graphics and effects.

9: UI

 Adjust the User Interface to be more fluent.

10: Inventory System

 Improve and balance inventory system.


This is a long list and we can't promise to change all of the above. We also can't tell you how long these changes will take. In the meanwhile, we would appreciate any suggestion as we want to focus on the most important things to change.  We're available for any question and suggestion in our discord channel.

Hallo Ellarians,

Today, we are celebrating six months since Legends of Ellaria was released. Thanks to you, we've made many changes during that time, both in visuals and game tweaks.

We've also added new graphics in today's version and a special discount on our store page to celebrate this occasion.

We want to thank everyone who gave us feedback. Even after its release, you've helped us polish, balance, and add essential parts to Legends of Ellaria. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/2b529c66629c04b1c9aab534840fb8e3e62cee8b.gif



In the past six months, we've changed the following:


 Made major optimizations to the game.

 Improved graphics, lighting and atmosphere.

 Improved, fixed and tweaked the user interface.

 Balanced and tweaked the Druid class to be an unstoppable support class.

 Balanced and tweaked the Rift Mage as a multi role mage, able to teleport easier, use guided projectiles and versatile spells. Also, the Rift mage now has the largest maximum mana stat skill points from all mage classes.

 Balanced and tweaked the elemental mage class to deliver more raw damage per spell. 

 Balanced and tweaked the ranger class to have more accuracy at earlier levels, draw arrows faster, deliver more damage and consume less stamina per shot. The ranger class is most dangerous in higher levels, especially when supported by your soldiers.

 Balanced and tweaked kingdom management to allow you to build larger kingdoms and use strategic locations. Multiple buildings stats and kingdom management cap penalty were changed based on community requests and rebalancing.

 Tweaked the Kingdom research tree to give more versatility to economics and management tree.

 Balanced and tweaked weaker military units, such as militia, to allow for an easier start and an easier kingdom defense through your progress.

 Added a "Demolish" button to city construction

 Improved "Defense Bonus" logic to city and world constructions.

 Chapter I is unlocked even if you didn't finish the tutorial.

 Made multiple changes to the tutorial.

 Changed and tweaked multiple quests and dialogues.

 Improved the AI and path finding.

 Fixed bugs and added multiple changes based on your suggestions.

 Added melee effect and sound.
 Added hit effect and blood effect for melee attacks.
 Reduced the number of combat shouts for the player during melee attacks.

 Reduced base bow stamina cost from 6 to 4 for short bow.
 Reduced base bow stamina cost from 7 to 5 for composite bow.
 Reduced base bow stamina cost from 10 to 7 for long bow.
 Increased Outpost Defense Bonus from 20 to 50.


And again, we wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to fix and tweak any issue we'll find and balance and add things by your suggestion. 

In future versions, we will:


 Continue to balance kingdom and combat
 Continue to optimize Legends of Ellaria
 Fix bugs and add tweaks based on your suggestion
 Add the Necromancer class


Please continue to play and send us any issues you encounter, and we will address those issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.11 - Combat Classes Balancing
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e9826197ed08d93a713f826e4de6faed56ce1258.png

Hallo Ellarians,

We just uploaded a new version with major balancing to combat damages and stats and a few minor fixes to dialogues and combat mechanics.

We took some of your suggestions and made some extensive tests to make sure that all the player classes are balanced. Some of the classes were weaker than others, and some, like the mage class, were strong at the beginning but would not scale properly as you level up.

Our biggest change was to the ranger class, as we've significantly increased the damage and accuracy at lower levels. We've made sure that the ranger class will be much deadlier and that you won't have to be level 15 or above to gain high bow accuracy

In addition, we fixed a persistent fire enchantment effect that would stay after the effect was done. We also made sure that the player will be able to remove the fire enchantment effect by casting the "Minor Dispel." We also fixed several issues with the merchant guild dialogues.

We wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to fix and tweak any issue we'll find and balance and add things by your suggestion. Also, stay tuned for the Necromancer DLC.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/49dcf0930eaf3dcb935af21718dd7f64d14a30d0.png

Good day Ellarians! As you may remember, the beta version of the first chapter of the single-player campaign of Legends of Ellaria has been available for a few days now. We haven’t found any major issues and we received requests to advance the version, so we’ve decided to roll it on to the main branch: everyone who owns the game (or who gets it now) will get this content too. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/8d2d2b91b0c5a523204a0a0fb1808cc6f5ca032a.png

What's changed since the last verison

 100+ quests, stories, events, and lore items.
 100+ locations, indoors and dungeons to explore.
 100+ dialogues where you can talk to almost any NPC in the world.
 A new kingdom management system, which includes happiness, crime, management, research, and new buildings.
 The merchant guild, mercenary guild, academy, mage tower, and different ways to hire armies and expand your kingdom.
 A new faction A.I and faction expansion. Factions will also send raiding parties and armies to target your towns and outposts.
 Reworked the armies battle system and RTS system and A.I , aded heroes and armies, as well as new systems such as army strength and morale.
 The world changes depending on the state of your kingdom, bandits set outposts or neutral settlements rise depending on your influence.
 A new tutorial and introduction to Ellaria, as well as advice and information given by your advisor.
 New items, weapons, clothes, class balances, and combat tweaks.
 Tons of other new features such as farming, mining, collecting research, using RiftStone to boost your kingdom, world events and much more.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/82c8e3f6aa3333734c41adb3bba1b96d592b82a6.jpg

Keep in mind that although this version is as stable as the previous one, there are still some things left to polish, fix, and optimize. We're hoping to receive as much feedback and suggestions, both through the Steam discussions, our Discord server, and through the in-game report sender. If you experience any issue during your gameplay, please press F8, and send us a report.

We want to thank our wonderful community for all the feedback they’re providing us with. Your feedback helped us improve the current version. We will continue to post versions in the Beta branch for your approval before posting them to the main branch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/922c88fc82b69169ad9f855260c29f7f8feb3585.jpg

Happy holidays and a safe and healthy 2021 to all of you!

If you own a copy of Legends of Ellaria but still haven't joined the closed Beta, please join us on our Discord server, PM us with @Admin and we will let you know the steps you have to take to join the beta. You’ll also be joining our great community of Ellarians – the best place to exchange tips and tricks for becoming the most powerful ruler in the continent, as well as sharing other common interests! If you don’t use Discord but want to check the beta out, leave us a message in this announcement and we’ll reach out to you privately.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/d1c50aa44c58f9e64c1c078331ad2cd345a1dba4.jpg

The wind howls, and there are strange whispers in the dark. The sound of soft footsteps come from empty, long forsaken rooms. Around a crackling fire, the elders tell stories of old – stories of hags and warlocks, wicked tricksters and evil spirits. Halloween is here, and the spooky season comes to Ellaria too! 

It’s been some time since our last update; we’ve been hard at work developing new content for the game, and we’re really excited to share with you some details about the next update of Legends of Ellaria. This will be one of the biggest updates in a long long time, so buckle up to check what’s coming to your kingdom! 

New locations to explore 

Ellaria will be even bigger with new maps and locations to explore, with miles of terrain full of new dangers – and rewards for those brave enough to face these challenges. A multitude of new dungeons, caves, camps and villages will be added to the world map. Each new map is 2 in-game miles wide – about 8 times bigger than they were before, and with more things to do than ever! 

New quests and events

We hope you have not stashed your weapon of choice too far if you felt at some point you were running out of adventures, we’re adding more than one hundred quests and events for you to experience, as well as new items to search! These quests may not only help you to level up your character, but also to affect your kingdom as a whole. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/5949924da5cad6c0c500d7a57fda169a7faa3d1f.jpg

A new kingdom…

In the last months we’ve discussed how kingdom management was shaping up – you can read our dev diaries about it here and here. Finally, these features are coming to the game! Mine for resources, construct buildings in your cities (more than 20 new buildings added!) and research technologies to upgrade them, keep your army morale up and win battles to expand your borders.  

…and new ways to rule it 

You can be a ruler with an iron fist, expanding your kingdom through war and conquest, or an adventurer king who goes on special quests. You can hire mercenaries or improve your economy to keep a strong standing army. Real-time strategy battles have been revamped for a better strategic experience. There are many different approaches to governing – follow your heart and instincts to become the most powerful ruler of Ellaria! 

Take detours

Ruling and going on adventures are just two of the many things you can do in Ellaria. Help your settlers working in the farmlands or mining for resources, talk to them to hear their personal stories, collect Artifacts for the librarian… even the new loading screen has minigames!

That’s is the tip of the iceberg: just about every feature of the game has received some kind of improvement, a huge step closer in our road towards full release. If all this sounds interesting… we have to say that it is only the beginning, for there is something even bigger coming to Legends of Ellaria: finally, the campaign main story is coming to the game! A story of heroes and villains, politics and intrigues, with many different characters, quests and epic battles, the main story spans through five chapters with multiple choices and side optional missions. In this next major update we’re releasing the first chapter of the main story – but that’s all we can tell you for now. We’ll give you more details about this in a few days, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Optimizations And Tweaks Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/36fd4ccfe46421eb4e649f14b15719dd1723987e.gif

Dear Legends of Ellaria players,

In the past few weeks, we've made important optimizations to our game engine, as well as tweaks and fixes from discussions and bug reports.

These changes are a part of a long-awaited expansion of our gameplay engine, which will allow us to integrate the new quest systems and remaining features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/765298e690996aa33dae07dd2f67609283e6c4cb.jpg

The first thing we focused on was to reduce texture and memory size. For that end, we've implemented a new system that loads textures in memory depending on where you are.

Another thing we've fixed is the pathfinding and movement logics. The citizens were colliding with some objects on their way to places, and enemies were jumping on top of each other when fighting in large formations. We've fixed these issues and also fixed followers and movement issues in small spaces. 

As a bonus, we've also improved the combat animations and tweaked some elements of the combat, both for small and large battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/fae007d031f98c11979ebc87e1bacabb3c6b5b5b.gif

In addition, we've changed much of our sky rendering, which improved the speed and also shows better clouds and skies.

Its been a busy month, as we went over multiple areas of LoE and reduced multiple overloads that were causing sudden frame rate drops, such as in combat or in cities. We also collected bug reports and fixed multiple bugs in management, logics, graphics and more. We'll continue to improve LoE as we go. Thank you for your help and for all the bug reports!

notes.title: Progress Report - January
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/fa6658cd6e6dd6380d523282321dd083be35a57c.gif

Dear Legends of Ellaria players,

Based on Closed Beta feedbacks, we've completed many tasks during this month. We're nearly finished the next stable Closed Beta version.

We've also made progress in multiple features and locations both for the world map and game mechanics, and we're expecting the official Early Access version to be ready within weeks.

Along with game mechanics, we've made it possible to conduct large battles in First Person mode. 

We have tested as many as 50 soldiers in the field, and we're hoping to raise this number to hundreds. The battle consists of waves of attackers and defenders until one of the sides runs out of soldiers or retreats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/a6e09e92bdcf725fa45704d1ded2aea55410236d.gif

A battle is connected to the world view, so you can either resolve the battle by waiting for it to conclude, or by entering First Person and fight by yourself. We've also ensured that if the attacker has less strength than the defender, the attacker will have penalties and will have fewer soldiers in the field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/897db85cf97b7204fd4ce13fd743e7fcfe4f5bc0.gif

You can command your soldiers through RTS (Real-Time Strategy) menu, or through Attack / Defend / Follow quick commands from the first person. If you have enough soldiers and don't need to strategize, you can just rush forward with your soldiers set to follow you. You'll be constantly surrounded by your own soldiers as they get reinforcements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/f99390e9fe1d4b9afe948c45d0c7c5540800a0b2.jpg

We've also made new places of interest, armies, places with fixed bonus and places that you can build. We've also added one-time events, that disappear once you clear them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/4d72b11b2f8e09f341ff458efeb4b33ee8037881.jpg

We're still working on more concepts and places of interest, and we're excited about the results. We've created several times more exploration, locations, and logics than the legacy version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/f0958f0112fb7a983ecb589867ba12fd9b43edf1.jpg

As we're finishing more milestones, we're closer to a stable Early Access than ever. We'd prefer not to post an official date yet, but based on our expectations, the Early Access version may be ready as soon as within two weeks.

If you own a copy of Legends of Ellaria but still haven't joined the closed Beta, please join us on our Discord server, PM us with @Admin and we will set you up! In case you don't have a Discord, you can also contact us here.

Thank you for the support, and we hope to build a great game alongside you.

See you in Ellaria,

The Larkon Studio Team

notes.title: Merchants, RPG, and World Domination
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/860323be185f76ceb1f0180a3fe882768b3c535d.gif

Dear Legends of Ellaria players,

We have a very special announcement for this upcoming winter.

After building the foundation of Legends of Ellaria's essential features, were ready take a step further and bring YOU a step further into the experience. 

When we first envisioned  LoE, we thought about a truly unique game that we as developers & gamers would love to play. As we thought and scrambled through ideas, mixing an Adventure-RPG with an RTS game in one gave the concept so many capabilities in which you could not only explore a world but build a kingdom within it; This also gave us ideas of, what if you could be more than an adventurer in the game, what if you could be king? 

And so, the idea of a world where you could explore, build, command, fight, trade, and rule all-in-one game became what is today an Early Access version of Legends of Ellaria. 

Our latest version includes the long-awaited merchant and new elements in our RPG and leveling system, such as the Warrior and Shieldsman classes. We will continue updating LoE on a weekly basis and expect the World Domination version to come out soon

It's been a long journey to get to this point, and we are finally ready to bring you further features this winter!

The current version includes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/5ccae7ca3a6c4ca01b8c5e62cccbbb1d219728a4.gif


 RPG, classes and a new character interface
 The Warrior Class
 The Shieldman Class, new armor logics and interface
 A new combat control system which is smoother and more intuitive
 The new vendor and unique items to buy, found in the market, tavern, blacksmith and Riverside village after completing their quest.


Some of the new features we will include: 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/eaaee5fc3a0b0f3884cf20286a77cf80f2bbda2d.png


 Build towns, manage your kingdom, recruit armies
 Explore and conquer regions of a vast and mysterious world
 Conquer other kingdoms, defend your own. 
 Use siege weapons, build walls


As well as the following fixes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/c4c8375cac9df8b17bae70b640a1ff95a3e66c00.gif


 Major controller and animation fixes
 Some NPC behavior fixes
 Graphics and interface tweaks and alignment



As you know, we have a closed-beta in which owners of Legends of Ellaria gain access to features BEFORE they're officially released, as well as having the chance to send us feedback directly through our Discord (link). 

If you're interested in building the game along with us, this is the perfect chance to do it.
If you own a copy of Legends of Ellaria but still haven't joined the closed Beta please join us on our Discord server, PM us with @Admin and we will set you up! In case you don't have a Discord, then just contact us here.

If you don't own a copy yet, it's time! We will have sales to celebrate winter, Christmas, and our incoming major updates, so this is the perfect opportunity to enjoy and build a game that brings you a memorable experience. 

Thank you to all of you that have left reviews, feedback, comments, add to wishlist, tweets, PMs, forums, blogs, videos, and streams. We are truly grateful that you're part of the LoE community and we will continue to build an epic game alongside you. 

See you in Ellaria, 

Larkon Studio

Dear community, 

We wanted to update you on recent progress with Legends of Ellaria. As you know, we have been slowing updates down to work on bigger features such as the RPG system and the Sphere of influence. 

We are now building this for the game and as of now we have progressed on the following fixes and features: 

1. There's a new visual editor for the RPG system, which will allow us to define classes, attributes, and skills in the upcoming RPG update.

2. The RPG system is expected to have a proficiency-based leveling system, where you'll invest proficiency points for each level you gain. Proficiencies (Warrior, Ranger, Mage, Diplomat, and more) will boost your abilities in said proficiency and will give you the ability to unlock Talents. These talents (Whirlwind, City Manager, Swordsman, and more) will improve your stats and may unlock skills to use during combat.

3. We are almost done with the First Person view mechanism. You will now be able to switch between first and third person mode by pressing “F”(or rebinding it to your preferred key). There are some camera differences between first and third person view, where going sideways makes the player face the desired direction, while in first person it will always face in the direction that the camera is facing. 

4. In addition we are working on IK (Inverse Kinematic) allowing the players and other NPC’s act much more flexible and accurate to the terrain and environment they're in.
Our next Major Update Part 1 will include First Person view, IK, “WASD” key bindings and more :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/af6f0c835a581d6ae3cf5f39b6429a30e7f82467.png

Dear community,

The second major update for Legends of Ellaria is here! 

After many suggestions, feedback, reviews, private messages, emails, dev talks, and beta testing, we decided to prioritize on the critical issues many of you were having.

 Reduced initial RAM usage by over 50%. The game should now load faster and use less memory overall.
 Outdoor objects now getting wet when it rains.
 A second floor to the player's home, which includes more chests and props.
 A "sleep" feature for your king, accessible through the player’s home.
 A more challenging melee combat system.
 Smarter civilian NPCs that now use roads whenever possible.
 Player walks faster.
 Soldiers following you into dungeons when they are in follow state; Otherwise, they will perform the command you have given them.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/fc8f21885ca473626eec7831cc71eff2aef91aaa.jpg

 Fixed an issue where civilians were walking irregularly while carrying wood

Notes from the Part 1:
Completely overhauled the construction:

When placing a building: Buildings check if they can be constructed by their shape and not by a general distance from other buildings
When placing a building: Buildings cannot be built inside a mountain or close to a cliff - which removes bugs related to doors inside mountains or buildings in the air
When constructing a new building, the terrain gets flat exactly where it should, and not as a general circle around the building.
Buildings snap to the terrain by their entrance and not by their center. The front entrance is always linked to the terrain smoothly
To compensate for the new system, old saves will try to snap the buildings into a more manageable position. If you encounter any problem with old saves, please send us your save file and we will fix it.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/223948169809b709be6c7a08a4c3c204c5f13013.jpg

Fixed an issue where the terrain would be flat or have flat portions

Enemies try to avoid the Circle of Fire spell whenever possible
Completely rebuild the Pathfinder system; NPC goes smoother and smarter from place to place.
Improved Followers and RTS Commands:
Followers can now follow you indoors. When you enter a dungeon, 3 of your best soldiers will go in with you.
Followers won’t wander too far from you unless instructed to. When in combat, followers will disengage and return to you in a tactical way if you are too far from them.

notes.title: Major Update #2 and Beta Dev Progress
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/f9dfbbcf63a9add97a3eaa6ac5053e7338d9c0df.jpg
You will now be able to take your army inside for a dungeon raid!

Development Progress:

Dear community, we have been reviewing all of your feedback through the Steam discussions, reviews, and our Discord server. We wanted to take the time to tell you a little more about our development schedule, and why we decided to work on the optimizations that we have instead of building upon new features for this update. 

We read every single one of your reviews, comments, feedback, suggestions, and even rants, furthermore we also take action based on them. Some of you are having critical issues with game crashes, bugs, and slow performance with the game, so instead of adding more cool stuff into it, we thought it would be best to first polish what we have built until now. 

This is also why next week we will finally open our Beta for which some of you have been registered to (In case you haven't and wish to join, write us here or DM via the Steam profile). 

The beta version will include the following: 
1: reduced usage of virtual memory, which is the main cause of the game crashes as well as the player appearing under the ground bug. 
2: new and a better-optimized weather system which increases FPS as well.
3: Some new and better-performing camera effects.
4: New and much less CPU consuming pathfinder system. 
5: New army formations in RTS mode, the soldiers will now follow you on formation when possible, and will gather near you in tight places.
6: Soldiers in your army will now go with you inside dungeons.

Within the Beta, you will test all these features, and we will prepare for our second major update this February 15, which will include: 

1: All the above + further FPS increase as well as a new and better-performing environment system.
2: A fixed citizens algorithm, correcting misc. bugs that make them act unpredictably (and in some cases, in a funny/buggy way).
3: Groups in RTS mode, you will be able to select soldiers and add them to groups and command groups using hotkeys.
4: Better combat AI, NPCs will avoid the circle of fire and others dangers, and they will be more aggressive and smarter when in combat mode.

Basically, with your help, we will have a much better-performing game, which will then help us build tons of new features that you have all been asking.


A short debrief of what to expect after the 15\2 version:

A week or 2 after, we will finally release new quests and maps, followed by implementing a full RPG Leveling system, a sphere of Influence with the world map(by April), the Market, Destructible walls and finally, a multiplayer experience (by Summer). For more details please check our Development Road Map

If you have any other ideas or suggestions, please let us know through a Steam review, your review helps us a lot and are we deeply appreciate your opinion.



See you in Ellaria, 

Larkon Studio

notes.title: Version 0.5.38.8 - Bug fixes, Key binding and character movement
notes.content:
Version 0.5.38.8 is now Live with some of the bug fixes and features you have been asking us! 

We want to say thank you to all of you that have been leaving reviews and giving us feedback through our different channels; we're working hard on improving the bug reports you have sent as well the suggestions you've mentioned. 

This new version includes a basic Key Binding and a smoother movement control for your character. We've also fixed some important issues with Legends of Ellaria by your request.

New Features:


Your character has a smoother control. There is no delay between pressing the movement control and the character moves towards the direction you have set without a slow rotation.
Character has a "Default Walk or Run" (Set by Caps Lock), both for combat and casual mode
Key binding (still missing several commands, including the WASD. We will add them soon)
 Game configuration and saves now exist in : C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\LocalLow\Larkon Studio\Legends of Ellaria


Fixed Issues:


Fixed an issue where LoE is stuck in "Game is Loading." 
Fixed more issues with permission to "My Documents." 
May have fixed the spinning camera issue with for people who own a Joystick. See "Known Issues"


Known issues:

Can't change the movement (WASD) keys binding
 When helping to construct a building, the building is not constructed and the game has issues with saving and loading
Not all Joysticks and Gamepads were tested for the spinning camera bug. Some Joystick owners may experience an issue where the camera is constantly rotating around them. If you have this issue, please send us a report or email with your Joystick / Gamepad model information.

See you In Ellaria, 

Larkon Studio

 Re balanced melee weapon ranges

 Your character is no longer wet indoor when it's raining outside
 Fixed player moves without pressing a move button
 Fixed an issue when switching between bow and a spell
 Fixed Kill the Raiders and RiverSide Quests
 Fixed several issues with dungeons
 Fixed Cave crawler not being hit
 Fixed civilian animation bugs
 Fixed followers animation bugs


* This new update does not spoil your save game.
